expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p4) is likewise a completely blank printed grid — zero rows, summing to 0.00, equal to the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell and to both of the schedule's own printed footer cells, all four written as slashed zeros and confirmed by a 700 dpi crop (pct:70,86.5,25,8@p4). ⚠ NOTE THE SCOPE DISTINCTION THAT MAKES THIS FILING WORTH READING CAREFULLY: Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' for expenditures prints 1,076.77 — a REAL cumulative figure — while Column A is zero. Utah County is a per-period regime, so the anchor is the zero, and the 1,076.77 is NOT summed as an increment and is NOT evidence that this report has unread expenditure rows: it is money this filer spent in EARLIER 2014 periods, itemized on earlier reports, and it is exactly equal (with sign flipped) to the beginning balance at line 3. An agent anchoring on Column B here would manufacture 1,076.77 of phantom unreconciled rows out of an honestly empty schedule.

escalation_note: Two verification crops at 700 dpi, both to settle the NIL MARKS rather than any figure: pct:70,84.5,25,8@p3 rendered Schedule A's 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total Contributions Received … $' cells, each holding an oval struck through by a diagonal stroke — a slashed zero, not a bare dash; pct:70,86.5,25,8@p4 rendered the same pair of cells on Schedule B with the same glyph.
